evidence: Observed design near miss, 13 November 2026: public unauthenticated access was technically available, but current Coinbase terms section 3(5) restrict AI research without consent. No unauthorised ingestion occurred. See INCIDENT.md.
Labelled practice scenario: an openly licensed environmental source still needs purpose, attribution and licence review at activation.
Labelled counterexample: reading public API documentation without activating a feed should not invoke an acquisition gate.
Labelled counterexample: editing an existing source decision note without acquiring data does not activate a source.
